notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable embedded federation-listing development slice to source-derived IEEE 1516.1-2025 records. It checks the official List services and their Report callbacks through real Catch2 selectors in both callback models. The Requirements Lab currently exports no higher-level implementation mapping for these records, so this is source/test traceability only—not a service catalog entry, JUnit result, protected-review result, production package claim, or conformance claim.
